sources.title: zyrabitcore/zyrabit-slm - Docker Image
sources.snippet: Zyrabit SLM is a production-ready local AI stack designed for organizations that prioritize data sovereignty. It enables high-performance inference, knowledge retrieval (RAG), and security scrubbing without ever sending a single byte to the public cloud.

sources.title: Zyrabit — Sovereign AI Infrastructure
sources.snippet: A complete Sovereign AI stack — small language model, vector store, redaction layer and observability — running on your infrastructure. No external network calls, no telemetry, no data leaves your perimeter.

sources.title: Zyrabit SLM | Zyrabit Docs
sources.snippet: Zyrabit SLM is a production-grade Small Language Model (SLM) orchestration stack designed for on-premise and private cloud environments. It provides a containerized architecture to deploy, manage, and scale local AI capabilities while maintaining strict data privacy and network isolation.
